description: Submit many email addresses for asynchronous bulk verification. Returns a batchId immediately; the job runs in the background. Poll get_batch_status until status is 'completed', then call get_batch_results. Reserves 1 credit per address. Prefer verify_email for one-off checks.

emails.description: Array of email addresses to verify.

name.description: Optional human-friendly label for the batch.

webhookUrl.description: Optional HTTPS URL to receive a signed batch.completed callback.

name: verify_batch
